ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Emily Dickinson

code.originalText: Video visit for the six-month kidney review, with home vital signs and home blood tests

text.paragraph: Video visit for the six-month kidney review. [S]

Ms. Dickinson is seen by video from her home; the mobile phlebotomy service drew blood and collected a urine sample this morning, and she measured her vital signs with her own devices before the call. She feels well, with no headaches since the spring. Her home blood pressure averages 118/72. She takes losartan 100 mg, dapagliflozin 10 mg, amlodipine 5 mg, atorvastatin 20 mg, and vitamin D3 daily and has taken no NSAIDs. She has had no lightheadedness, ankle swelling, urinary symptoms, or muscle aches. She would like her second hepatitis B dose and her influenza vaccine at her preventive visit next month, so that she makes one trip. [S]
